mapper.sql: select r.refund_id, r.refund_no, r.order_no, r.order_id, r.store_id, r.user_id, r.user_name, r.amount, r.reason, r.status, r.refund_method, r.audit_by, r.audit_time, r.audit_remark, r.finish_time, r.create_by, r.create_time, r.update_by, r.update_time, s.store_name from pet_refund r left join pet_store s on s.store_id = r.store_id
mapper.select: select count(*) from pet_refund where order_no = #{orderNo} and status = '0'
mapper.insert: insert into pet_refund (refund_no, order_no, order_id, store_id, user_id, user_name, amount, reason, status, refund_method, create_by, create_time) values (#{refundNo}, #{orderNo}, #{orderId}, #{storeId}, #{userId}, #{userName}, #{amount}, #{reason}, #{status}, #{refundMethod}, #{createBy}, sysdate())
mapper.select:
select ifnull(sum(case when status = '0' then 1 else 0 end), 0) as pending, ifnull(sum(case when status = '1' and date(finish_time) = #{date} then amount else 0 end), 0) as refunded, ifnull(sum(case when status = '1' then 1 else 0 end), 0) as done, ifnull(sum(case when status = '2' then 1 else 0 end), 0) as rejected from pet_refund
store_id = #{storeId}
